name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

k8sServiceAccount.description:
Name of Service Account that backs the entity (Apps, Envs) for RBAC
Has to be pre-created

providerType.description:
Provider type for this security profile. Used by {@link #inst} to determine which
CloudSecurityProfile subtype (Aws, Azure, Gcp, or OnPrem) to return.

If set to a specific provider type (AWS, AZURE, GCP, or ONPREM), {@link #inst} will return
the corresponding subtype profile. If not specified, {@link #inst} will infer the provider type
from the Kubernetes cluster type (GKE, AKS, EKS).

iamServiceAccount.description:
Name of the associated IAM Service Account in GCP.

Note: The IAM Service Account fully qualified name is of the following format: 'IAM_SERVICEACCOUNT_NAME@GCP_PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com',
where GCP_PROJECT_ID is the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) project id for this cluster and where the IAM_SERVICEACCOUNT was created.

projectId.description:
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) project id for this CloudSecurityProfile.Gcp.
This is the globally unique identifier of your project where the {@link iamServiceAccount} has been created or
will be created. Its details can be found at https://console.cloud.google.com/cloud-resource-manager.

title:
